bal_defense_vs_jax_offense.scheme_verdict: Baltimore plays Two-High MOFO on 59.5% of snaps and <=5 in the box on 77.95% of dropbacks to cap explosive air yards and force patience underneath (Parker Washington 48 targets, Brenton Strange 35 targets, Jakobi Meyers 31 targets). BDB2025 (16,124 plays) proves Trevor Lawrence's MOFO-vs-MOFC delta is only -0.0149 EPA/play (not -0.17), while Baltimore's light boxes invite JAX early-down rushing (Chris Rodriguez Jr. +0.120 EPA/rush if Bhayshul Tuten is Out).

jax_defense_vs_bal_offense.scheme_verdict: With Lamar Jackson (IR - thumb surgery) and Tyler Huntley (Out for season - turf toe) both excluded, undrafted rookie Joe Fagnano starts at QB1 for Baltimore (-0.4308 EPA/dropback on 24 W8 dropbacks) with Jacoby Brissett acquired 2026-11-04 from ARI as emergency QB2. Todd Monken is forced into a heavy Derrick Henry ground script (159 carries, 632 yds, 8 TDs; 2.52 YBC/att) + quick-game/screen releases to Zay Flowers and Mark Andrews against Jacksonville's 30.9% blitz / 34.78% PA-blitz front.
